extension.description: Reviews cluster mutations, remote execution, file transfer, tunnels, certificate decisions, and Helm lifecycle operations.
extension.name: Kubernetes operation protection

permissions.description: Identifies annotation mutations on cluster resources.
permissions.label: Kubernetes annotate
safer_guidance: Use --local or a dry run and review the exact annotation keys and resource scope first.

permissions.description: Identifies declarative create or update operations against cluster resources.
permissions.label: Kubernetes apply
safer_guidance: Render a client-side dry run and review the exact namespace and diff before applying.

permissions.description: Identifies creation or mutation of autoscaling behavior for workloads.
permissions.label: Kubernetes autoscale
safer_guidance: Use a dry run and review minimum, maximum, and target utilization before enabling autoscaling.

permissions.description: Identifies approval or denial of certificate signing requests that affect cluster identities.
permissions.label: Kubernetes certificate request decision
safer_guidance: Inspect the CSR signer, usages, subject, and requester identity before making a decision.

permissions.description: Identifies file transfer between the local machine and a container.
permissions.label: Kubernetes file copy
safer_guidance: Copy only an explicitly reviewed non-secret path and verify the source and destination Pod.

permissions.description: Identifies imperative creation of cluster resources and generated resource requests.
permissions.label: Kubernetes create
safer_guidance: Use a client-side dry run and review the generated resource before creation.

permissions.description: Identifies debug operations that can add ephemeral containers, copy Pods, or enter node namespaces.
permissions.label: Kubernetes debug session
safer_guidance: Use the narrowest debug target and profile, and avoid host namespace access unless required.

permissions.description: Identifies deletion of live cluster resources.
permissions.label: Kubernetes resource deletion
safer_guidance: Run a client-side dry run and review the exact resource names and namespace first.

permissions.description: Identifies node drains that evict workloads and make a node unschedulable.
permissions.label: Kubernetes node drain
safer_guidance: Preview the drain and verify disruption budgets, node identity, and workload scope first.

permissions.description: Identifies interactive editing that writes modified resources back to the cluster.
permissions.label: Kubernetes edit
safer_guidance: Export the resource, review a diff, and apply a reviewed manifest instead of editing live state.

permissions.description: Identifies arbitrary command execution inside a running container.
permissions.label: Kubernetes remote execution
safer_guidance: Prefer read-only inspection and avoid exposing secrets or host-mounted paths to the session.

permissions.description: Identifies creation of Services that expose workloads on cluster networking.
permissions.label: Kubernetes expose
safer_guidance: Use a client-side dry run and review service type, ports, selectors, and namespace first.

permissions.description: Identifies forced replacement that deletes and recreates a resource without graceful handoff.
permissions.label: Forced Kubernetes replace
safer_guidance: Use ordinary replace or apply after reviewing a dry run instead of forced recreation.

permissions.description: Identifies installation of a chart and its rendered resources into a cluster.
permissions.label: Helm release install
safer_guidance: Render or dry-run the chart and review values, hooks, images, and namespace before install.

permissions.description: Identifies rollback of a release to a previous revision.
permissions.label: Helm release rollback
safer_guidance: Inspect release history and dry-run the rollback before changing live resources.

permissions.description: Identifies uninstall operations that remove a release and its managed cluster resources.
permissions.label: Helm release removal
safer_guidance: Run Helm uninstall with dry-run and confirm the release and namespace first.

permissions.description: Identifies upgrades that replace or mutate resources owned by an existing release.
permissions.label: Helm release upgrade
safer_guidance: Dry-run the upgrade and review rendered manifests, hooks, values, and rollback readiness first.

permissions.description: Identifies label mutations that can change selectors, policy scope, or automation behavior.
permissions.label: Kubernetes label
safer_guidance: Use --local or a dry run and review selector and policy effects before changing labels.

permissions.description: Identifies cordon and uncordon operations that change whether a node accepts new workloads.
permissions.label: Kubernetes node scheduling change
safer_guidance: Use a dry run and verify the exact node and scheduling impact first.

permissions.description: Identifies partial mutation of live cluster resources.
permissions.label: Kubernetes patch
safer_guidance: Use --local or a dry run and inspect the resulting object before patching the cluster.

permissions.description: Identifies local network tunnels to Pods, Services, or other cluster resources.
permissions.label: Kubernetes port forward
safer_guidance: Bind only to loopback, forward the minimum required port, and verify the exact target first.

permissions.description: Identifies replacement of live cluster resources without forced deletion.
permissions.label: Kubernetes replace
safer_guidance: Use a dry run and compare the full replacement object with the live resource first.

permissions.description: Identifies workload restarts that replace running Pods.
permissions.label: Kubernetes rollout restart
safer_guidance: Review rollout status, disruption budgets, and workload health before restarting.

permissions.description: Identifies rollback of a workload to a previous rollout revision.
permissions.label: Kubernetes rollout undo
safer_guidance: Inspect rollout history and use a dry run before selecting the revision to restore.

permissions.description: Identifies creation and execution of a new Pod from a container image.
permissions.label: Kubernetes run
safer_guidance: Use a client-side dry run and review image, service account, environment, and command first.

permissions.description: Identifies replica-count changes that can add or remove live workload instances.
permissions.label: Kubernetes scale
safer_guidance: Use a dry run and verify workload capacity and disruption constraints before scaling.

permissions.description: Identifies declarative set operations that mutate image, environment, resources, selectors, or identity.
permissions.label: Kubernetes set
safer_guidance: Use --local or a dry run and review the generated resource changes before applying them.

permissions.description: Identifies node taint changes that can alter workload placement or trigger evictions.
permissions.label: Kubernetes node taint
safer_guidance: Use a dry run and verify affected nodes, tolerations, and eviction consequences first.
